name: pc.notification-delivery-receipt.v1
authorityRules: The gateway observation signer is bound by the exact installed signed channel profile, separate from its issuer. Verify canonical framing, complete immutable attempt/context digests and scope before accepting an observation.

DELIVERED observes gateway delivery only. RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT is a definitive gateway no-effect assertion; only the durable owner may decide a later attempt using the existing exact five-delay policy and configured lower limit. PERMANENT_FAILURE is terminal. AMBIGUOUS requires original readback and cannot admit a new send.
Unknown transport result, lost ACK, 404, timeout, cancellation or failed owner commit is not a no-effect receipt. Readback cannot resubmit. Historical verification does not re-authorize dispatch.

Original signed bytes and receipt identity must be retained atomically with attempt outcome and outbox under the owning scope/revision fence. A verified receipt alone establishes neither SQL admission nor atomic durable completion.
Receipts contain digests and scoped identities only, never payload bodies, endpoint addresses, credentials or raw provider diagnostics.
